pfd-left.title: Left Primary Flight Display (PFD 1)
pfd-left.description: Primary Flight Display provides airspeed, attitude, altitude, vertical speed, flight modes, and course deviation information. In addition to the flight instruments, flight plan, navigation, communication, terrain, traffic, and weather information are also presented on the PFD.

mfd-left.title: Left Multi-Function Display (MFD 1) (STATUS / EICAS)
mfd-left.description:
The EICAS displays engine and system parameters such as flap, gear, spoilers and trim positions, total fuel quantity, APU, and environmental information.
The EICAS also displays crew awareness messages.
STATUS PAGE:
A dedicated page on MFD is available for the crew to achieve status information about:
-Flight
-Battery
-Engine Oil Level
-Brake
-Crew Oxygen
-Doors.

mfd-right.title: Right Multi-Function Display (MFD 2)
mfd-right.description: The Multi Function Display (MFD) contains menu softkeys, on the top and bottom of the screen, used to select formats and control various systems. The upper menu bar has three menu title buttons to select synoptics, map, and plan navigation formats. The synoptic formats selectable by the flight crew are displayed in the upper area of the screen. The lower menu bar has three menu title buttons to select TCAS zoom, weather virtual controller and electronic checklist in the lower area of the screen. If nothing has been selected for display in the lower area, it remains blank.

pfd-right.title: Right Primary Flight Display (PFD 2)
pfd-right.description: Displays First Officer primary flight instruments: attitude, airspeed, barometric altitude, vertical speed, heading/HSI, and AFCS Flight Mode Annunciations (FMA).

isis-screen.title: Integrated eletronic Stanby System (IESS)
isis-screen.description:
NORMAL OPERATION
During normal operation, the IESS computes and displays attitude, slip-skid indication, altitude (baro corrected), airspeed, vertical speed, Mach number and IESS. The buttons functionalities are:
- CAGE pushbutton: if depressed, the standby performs a CAGE in the internal gyros to cancel the accumulated drift. User: vlmorei0f - Printed by TechPubs - Aug 03/26 - 19:22:41
- ILS button: if pressed, glideslope and localizer deviations is displayed.
- STD button: if pressed, STD baro is set. To adjust baro, rotate the knob.
- '+' and '-' buttons: controls display brightness.
- 'Push FT-M' in the Guidance Panel: automatically displays altitude in meters.
- 'MAIN PNL' in the Overhead Panel: controls IESI bezel illumination.
The IESS is powered as soon as the airplane battery 1 is selected to ON and airplane battery 2 is selected to AUTO. Then, the IESS starts its alignment phase. The initial IESS alignment takes about 90 seconds to be completed and can be identified on the screen by the 'INIT 90 s' flag.
NOTE: The airplane must not be moved during the first 90 seconds after power-up, while the IESS is undergoing alignment. Moving the airplane during this period can cause in-flight attitude indication errors that may not be noticeable on ground.

mcdu-left-screen.title: Left Multifunction Control Display Unit (MCDU 1)
mcdu-left-screen.description: The MCDU allows radio tuning, PFD radio display setup, manual TRS, engine takeoff set, avionics display setup and test, performance initialization, flight planning, access to electronics CBs, and others.

mcdu-right-screen.title: Right Multifunction Control Display Unit (MCDU 2)
mcdu-right-screen.description: The MCDU allows radio tuning, PFD radio display setup, manual TRS, engine takeoff set, avionics display setup and test, performance initialization, flight planning, access to electronics CBs, and others.

dvdr-test-btn.title: DVDR Test Button
dvdr-test-btn.description: Simultaneously tests all CVR and FDR functions on both DVDR.

dvdr-erase-btn.title: CVR Erase Button
dvdr-erase-btn.description: Erases the recorded audio information, provided that the airplane is on the ground and Emergency/Parking Brake is applied.

elt-switch.title: ELT Selector Switch (ARM / ON)
elt-switch.description:
Controls the Emergency Locator Transmitter.
ARM: Automatically transmits on impact.
ON: Manually activates emergency transmission.

elec-idg1-knob.title: IDG 1 Selector Knob
elec-idg1-knob.description:
Controls Integrated Drive Generator 1.
AUTO: Automatic operation of the electrical main generation system.
OFF:  opens the IDG contactor isolating the IDG from the respective AC BUS. 
DISC: If held in this position for at least 1 second, mechanically disconnects the IDG.
 IDG FAULT INDICATION LED
The IDG fault indication LED illuminates indicating which IDG must be disconnected in case the EICAS message IDG 1 (2) OIL is displayed. The LED extinguishes after IDG disconnection.

elec-idg2-knob.title: IDG 2 Selector Knob
elec-idg2-knob.description:
Controls Integrated Drive Generator 1.
AUTO: Automatic operation of the electrical main generation system.
OFF:  opens the IDG contactor isolating the IDG from the respective AC BUS. 
DISC: If held in this position for at least 1 second, mechanically disconnects the IDG.
 IDG FAULT INDICATION LED
The IDG fault indication LED illuminates indicating which IDG must be disconnected in case the EICAS message IDG 1 (2) OIL is displayed. The LED extinguishes after IDG disconnection.

elec-apu-gen-btn.title: APU GEN Button
elec-apu-gen-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation of the electrical auxiliary generation system. 
PUSH OUT: opens the APU generator line contactor and isolates the APU generator from the AC BUS TIE

elec-gpu-btn.title: Ground Power Unit (GPU) Button
elec-gpu-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows the AC GPU to connect in the AC system, according to the source priority.
PUSH OUT: Isolates the AC GPU from the system.
AVAIL: Illuminates inside the button when the AC GPU is connected to the airplane and AC power quality requirements are satisfied.
IN USE: Illuminates inside the button when the AC GPU is powering the airplane AC electrical system.

elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.title: AC BUS TIES Selector Knob
elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.description:
Controls AC Bus Tie Contactors (BTC 1 & 2).
1 OPEN: opens the Bus Tie Contactor (BTC) 1, while (BTC) 2 is automatically operated.
AUTO: allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
2 OPEN: opens the Bus Tie Contactor (BTC) 2, while (BTC) 1 is automatically operated.

elec-tru1-knob.title: TRU 1 Selector Switch
elec-tru1-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU 1 from the respective DC BUS.

elec-tru-ess-knob.title: TRU ESS Selector Switch
elec-tru-ess-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU ESS from the DC ESS BUS 3.

elec-tru2-knob.title: TRU 2 SelectorSwitch
elec-tru2-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU 2 from the respective DC BUS.

elec-batt1-knob.title: BATT 1 Knob
elec-batt1-knob.description:
Battery (24V Ni-Cd)
ON: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. 
OFF: The battery supplies power to the HOT BATT BUS 1 only and is no longer connected to the airplane electrical system.
Power Up: Each battery voltage must be at least 22v

elec-batt2-knob.title: BATT 2 Knob
elec-batt2-knob.description:
Battery (24V Ni-Cd)
ON: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. 
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. OFF: The battery supplies power to the HOT BATT BUS 2 only and is no longer connected to the airplane electrical system.
Power Up: Each battery voltage must be at least 22v

elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.title: DC Bus Ties Selector Knob
elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.description:
AUTO: allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Precludes the closure of both essential tie contactors (ETCs) and the DC tie contactor (DCTC).

ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.title: OVHD PNL Controller
ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the brightness of the overhead panel lighting.

ckpt-main-lt-knob.title: MAIN PNL Controller
ckpt-main-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the lighting brightness of the main panel.

ckpt-ped-lt-knob.title: PEDESTAL Controller
ckpt-ped-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the lighting brightness of the pedestal panel.

ckpt-annun-test-btn.title: ANNUNCIATOR TEST Button
ckpt-annun-test-btn.description:
PUSH: when maintained pushed in all the striped bars and caption indications turn on to verify their integrity.
NOTE: The Cockpit Lights ANNUNCIATORS TEST Button does not check the GPU button light, the EMER/PRKG BRAKE light and the Fire Extinguisher Cargo Smoke FWD and AFT buttons lights.

ckpt-dome-sw.title: DOME Switch
ckpt-dome-sw.description: Turns the cockpit dome lights on and off.

fire-eng1-handle.title: Engine 1 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng1-handle.description:
ILLUMINATED: Indicates fire in the associated engine.
PULL: Closes the associated engine bleed air, fuel, hydraulic and crossbleed shutoff valves.
ROTATE (left or right): Discharges fire extinguisher bottles into the associated engine.

fire-cargo-fwd-btn.title: CARGO SMOKE FWD Button (Guarded)
fire-cargo-fwd-btn.description:
ILLUMINATED: Red striped bar indicates fire detection in the respective cargo compartment FWD.
PUSH: discharges the high and then the low-rate cargo extinguisher bottles of the associated cargo compartment when the red striped bar is illuminated.
MANUAL: Pressing the FWD button, when it is not illuminated, arms the associated extinguisher bottle and illuminates the button in red.

fire-cargo-aft-btn.title: CARGO SMOKE AFT Button (Guarded)
fire-cargo-aft-btn.description:
ILLUMINATED: Red striped bar indicates fire detection in the respective cargo compartment AFT.
PUSH: discharges the high and then the low-rate cargo extinguisher bottles of the associated cargo compartment when the red striped bar is illuminated.
MANUAL: Pressing the AFT button, when it is not illuminated, arms the associated extinguisher bottle and illuminates the button in red.

fire-test-btn.title: Fire Extinguisher TEST Button
fire-test-btn.description:
PRESS: Initiates the test of cargo smoke, EBAY smoke, engine and APU fire detection systems. If the fire extinguisher TEST button is pressed for more than 10 seconds, the APU automatically shuts-down.
CAUTION:PRESSING THE FIRE DETECTION TEST BUTTON FOR MORE THAN 10 SECONDS SHUTS DOWN THE APU.

fire-apu-extg-btn.title: FIRE EXTINGUISHER APU Button (Guarded)
fire-apu-extg-btn.description: PUSH: Closes the APU fuel shutoff valve and discharges the APU fire extinguisher bottle.

fire-eng2-handle.title: Engine 2 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng2-handle.description:
ILLUMINATED: Indicates fire in the associated engine.
PULL: Closes the associated engine bleed air, fuel, hydraulic and crossbleed shutoff valves.
ROTATE (left or right): Discharges fire extinguisher bottles into the associated engine.

fuel-xfeed-knob.title: Fuel XFEED Selector
fuel-xfeed-knob.description:
LOW 1: opens the crossfeed valve and automatically activates the right AC fuel pump (AC PUMP 2), supplying fuel to both engines from the right wing tank.
OFF: closes the crossfeed valve.
LOW 2: opens the crossfeed valve and automatically activates the left AC fuel pump (AC PUMP 1), supplying fuel to both engines from the left wing tank.

fuel-ac-pump1-btn.title: Fuel AC PUMP 1 Knob
fuel-ac-pump1-btn.description:
OFF: Deactivates the AC fuel pump 1.
AUTO: Automatically operates the AC fuel pump 1.
ON: Activates the AC fuel pump 1.

fuel-ac-pump2-btn.title: Fuel AC PUMP 2 Knob
fuel-ac-pump2-btn.description:
OFF: Deactivates the AC fuel pump 2.
AUTO: Automatically operates the AC fuel pump 2.
ON: Activates the AC fuel pump 2.

fuel-dc-pump-btn.title: FUEL DC PUMP Knob
fuel-dc-pump-btn.description:
OFF: Deactivates the fuel DC pump.
AUTO: Automatically operates the fuel DC pump according to the logic of the system.
ON: Activates the fuel DC pump.

pax-emer-lt-knob.title: EMER LT Selector
pax-emer-lt-knob.description:
OFF: Turns off emergency lights and prevents battery discharge.
ARM: Automatically illuminates emergency lights if normal electrical power is lost.
ON: Manually illuminates emergency interior and exterior lights.

pax-sterile-btn.title: ATTND CALL Button
pax-sterile-btn.description:
The attendant call sounds as a single hi/lo tone chime in the passenger cabin. 
NOTE: This button is not associated with the rainbow lights in the cabin.

pax-no-smk-sw.title: STERILE Switch
pax-no-smk-sw.description: Turns on and off the sterile lights located in the rainbow lights.

pax-fstn-belts-sw.title: NO ELEC DEVICES Switch
pax-fstn-belts-sw.description: Turns on and off the NO ELEC DEVICES signs.

pax-cabin-lt-sw.title: FSTN BELTS Switch
pax-cabin-lt-sw.description: Turns on and off the FASTEN BELTS signs.

apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.title: APU Fuel Shutoff Pushbutton
apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.description: Guarded pushbutton that commands the APU fuel shutoff valve to close, isolating fuel supply to the APU.

apu-emer-stop-btn.title: APU EMER STOP Button (Guarded)
apu-emer-stop-btn.description:
PUSH IN: closes the shutoff valve at fuel line that feeds the APU, shutting down the APU with no cooldown period. A white striped bar illuminates on the lower half of the button.
PUSH OUT: normal position, with the fuel shutoff valve open.
NOTE: When an APU fire is detected, a red striped bar illuminates on the upper half of the button.

apu-master.title: APU Master Selector Knob (OFF / ON / START)
apu-master.description:
OFF: Initiates normal shutdown of APU.
ON: Normal position when the APU is running.
START: (momentary action) initiates the start cycle of APU. When released, the switch moves to the ON position.

wiper-left-knob.title: WINDSHIELD WIPER 1 Knob
wiper-left-knob.description:
TIMER: Eight-seconds intermittent operation.
OFF: Stops windshield wipers in the stowed position.
LOW: windshield wipers operate at low speed.
HIGH: Windshield wipers operate at high speed.

wiper-right-knob.title: WINDSHIELD WIPER 2 Knob
wiper-right-knob.description:
TIMER: Eight-seconds intermittent operation.
OFF: Stops windshield wipers in the stowed position.
LOW: windshield wipers operate at low speed.
HIGH: Windshield wipers operate at high speed.

ext-logo-sw.title: LOGO Lights Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-logo-sw.description: Turns on and off the logotype lights.

ext-taxi-nose-sw.title: TAXI NOSE Light Switch
ext-taxi-nose-sw.description: Turns the nose-gear-mounted taxi light ON or OFF (automatically extinguishes when nose gear retracts).

ext-taxi-side-sw.title: TAXI SIDE (Runway Turnoff) Lights Switch
ext-taxi-side-sw.description: Turns the wide-beam side taxi lights ON or OFF.

ext-insp-sw.title: INSP (Wing Inspection) Lights Switch
ext-insp-sw.description: Illuminates the wing leading edges to visually check for ice accumulation at night.

ext-ldg-left-sw.title: Left LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-left-sw.description: Controls the left wing root high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-nose-sw.title: Nose LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-nose-sw.description: Controls the nose-gear high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-right-sw.title: Right LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-right-sw.description: Controls the right wing root high-intensity landing light.

hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 1 ENG PUMP SHUTOFF Shutoff Button
hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.description: PUSH IN: Closes the hydraulic shutoff valve (SOV), isolating the suction line of the respective engine driven pump (EDP) from the associated hydraulic system.

hyd-ptu-knob.title: PTU (Power Transfer Unit) Knob
hyd-ptu-knob.description:
OFF: turns the PTU off.
AUTO: allows the PTU to operate automatically. During takeoff and landing, the hydraulic system logic activates the PTU if the engine 2 or EDP 2 fails.
ON: operates the PTU continuously, overriding the hydraulic system logic.

hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 2 ENG PUMP SHUTOFF Shutoff Button
hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.description: PUSH IN: Closes the hydraulic shutoff valve (SOV), isolating the suction line of the respective engine driven pump (EDP) from the associated hydraulic system.

hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 1 ELEC PUMP Knob
hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.description:
OFF: Turns the associated electrical pump off.
AUTO:allows the associated electrical pump to operate automatically. In flight, it activates the electric pump in case of EDP or engine fail. On ground, it  is activated when the opposite engine is running (N2 higher than 54%) and Emergency/ Parking Brake is released, or during the PBIT of the respective ACMP.
ON: Operates the associated electrical pump continuously, overriding the system logic.

hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 2 ELEC PUMP Knob
hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls AC Motor Pump 2 (ACMP 2) providing backup and ground hydraulic pressure for System 2.

hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.title: SYS 3 ELEC PUMP A Knob
hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.description:
OFF: Turns the electrical pump off.
ON: Turns the electrical pump on.

hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.title: SYS 3 ELEC PUMP B Knob
hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.description:
OFF: turns the electrical pump off. 
AUTO: Allows  the  electrical  pump to operate automatically. In flight, it turns on the electric pump 3B whenever the electric pump 3A fails.
ON: Operates the electrical pump continuously, overriding the system logic.

press-cabin-alt-knob.title: CABIN ALT Controller
press-cabin-alt-knob.description:
DOWN: (momentary action) manually closes the outflow valve.
STOP: normal operation position.
UP:  (momentary action) manually opens the outflow valve.
NOTE: Manual actuation of the outflow valve is possible only with the PRESSURIZATION MODE SELECTOR set to MAN position. If the command is maintained for less than 2 seconds, the OFV speed is controlled at 0.5°/second. If the command is maintained for more than 2 seconds, the OFV speed is controlled at 2°/second.

press-mode-knob.title: PRESSURIZATION MODE Selector
press-mode-knob.description:
MAN: Allows manual control of the outflow valve.
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the pressurization system.
LFE CTRL: allows manual input of landing field elevation, although the pressurization system remains in automatic mode.

press-dump-btn.title: DUMP Button (Guarded)
press-dump-btn.description: PUSH IN: The DUMP Button activates emergency depressurization. A guard is installed over the switch to prevent inadvertent actuation. A white striped bar illuminates on the button. When pressed second time, the system returns to normal.

press-lfe-knob.title: LFE CTRL
press-lfe-knob.description:
DOWN: (momentary action) decreases the LFE in 100 ft increments.
STOP: Normal operation position. 
UP: (momentary action) increases the LFE in 100 ft increments.
NOTE: Manual input of the LFE is possible only with the PRESSURIZATION MODE SELECTOR set to LFE CTRL position.

ice-wshld1-btn.title: WINDSHIELD HEATING 1 Button
ice-wshld1-btn.description:
PUSH IN: windshield heating system operation in automatic mode.
PUSH OUT: deactivates the associated windshield heating system.

ice-wshld2-btn.title: WINDSHIELD HEATING 2 Button
ice-wshld2-btn.description:
PUSH IN: windshield heating system operation in automatic mode.
PUSH OUT: deactivates the associated windshield heating system.

ice-wing-btn.title: WING Anti-Ice Button
ice-wing-btn.description:
PUSH IN: automatic operation of the wing anti-ice system.
PUSH OUT: deactivates the wing anti-ice system.
NOTE: The Ice Protection MODE selector, even in ON position, does not bypass the WING button.

ice-mode-knob.title: ICE PROTECTION MODE Selector
ice-mode-knob.description:
ICE SPEED RESET: the system is reset to no-ice condition, allowing the stall warning system return to the normal operating speeds.
AUTO: automatic operation of the wing and engine anti-ice systems.
ON: activates the anti-ice system regardless of icing condition. The anti-ice system restrictions related to ground operation are still applicable.

ice-test-knob.title: Ice Detection TEST Controller
ice-test-knob.description:
ENG: Initiates the engine anti-ice system test.
OFF: Spring-loaded position.
WING: Provides a test for the wing anti-ice and ice detection systems.
NOTE: The Ice Protection TEST controller is used only by maintenance.

pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.title: CKPT Controler
pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.description:
Controls cockpit temperature relative to the controller position.
The 12 o'clock position refers to the temperature of 24°C.

pneu-recirc-btn.title: RECIRC Button
pneu-recirc-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation by the AMS. This position turns on both recirculation fans.
PUSH OUT: manually turns off both recirculation fans.

pneu-pax-temp-knob.title: PAX CABIN Controller
pneu-pax-temp-knob.description:
Controls passenger cabin temperature relative to the controller position.
The 12 o'clock position refers to the temperature of 24°C.
Rotating the controller to the ATTND position allows the cabin temperature control through the control panel of the flight attendant.

pneu-pack1-btn.title: PACK 1 Button
pneu-pack1-btn.description:
PUSH IN: activation of the Pack is subject to normal system control laws. This position opens the respective pack flow control valve.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the respective pack flow control valve.

pneu-pack2-btn.title: PACK  Button
pneu-pack2-btn.description:
PUSH IN: activation of the Pack is subject to normal system control laws. This position opens the respective pack flow control valve.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the respective pack flow control valve.

pneu-xbleed-btn.title: XBLEED Button
pneu-xbleed-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation by the AMS. This position opens the crossbleed valve.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the crossbleed valve.

pneu-bleed1-btn.title: BLEED 1 Button
pneu-bleed1-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation by the AMS. This position commands the respective engine bleed valves.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the engine bleed valves.
NOTE: When leak is detected, the button amber striped bar is illuminated.

pneu-apu-bleed-btn.title: APU BLEED Button
pneu-apu-bleed-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation by the AMS. This position commands the APU bleed valve according to system logic.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the APU bleed valve.
NOTE: When leak is detected, the button amber striped bar is illuminated.

pneu-bleed2-btn.title: BLEED 2 Button
pneu-bleed2-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation by the AMS. This position commands the respective engine bleed valves.
PUSH OUT: manually closes the engine bleed valves.
NOTE: When leak is detected, the button amber striped bar is illuminated.

oxy-mask-knob.title: MASKS DEPLOY Selector
oxy-mask-knob.description:
OFF: disables automatic deployment of passenger oxygen masks.
AUTO: enables automatic deployment of passenger oxygen masks when cabin pressure altitude is above 14000 ft.
OVRD: deploys the passenger oxygen masks regardless of cabin altitude.

oxy-supply-btn.title: MASKS DEPLOYED Indicator
oxy-supply-btn.description: An ON light illuminates, indicating that the passenger and the oxygen masks for the flight attendants have been deployed.

master-warn-left.title: Master Warning (WARN) Button Left
master-warn-left.description: The Master Warning (WARN button) is installed on the glareshield panel and its red light blinks when a warning CAS message (red messages) comes on the EICAS. A specific aural tone is triggered together with the master warning red light. The red light stops to blink and the aural tone to sound when the WARN button is pressed (message acknowledge) or when the failure condition no longer exists, but the warning CAS message on the EICAS stays as long as the failure condition exists.

master-caut-left.title: Master Caution (CAUT) Button Left
master-caut-left.description: The Master Caution (CAUT button) is installed on the glareshield panel and its amber light blinks when a caution CAS message (amber message) comes on the EICAS. A specific aural tone is triggered together with the master caution amber light. The amber light stops to blink and the aural tone to sound when the CAUT button is pressed (message acknowledge) or when the failure condition no longer exists, but the caution CAS message on the EICAS stays as long as the failure condition exists.

master-caut-right.title: Master Caution (CAUT) Button Right
master-caut-right.description: The Master Caution (CAUT button) is installed on the glareshield panel and its amber light blinks when a caution CAS message (amber message) comes on the EICAS. A specific aural tone is triggered together with the master caution amber light. The amber light stops to blink and the aural tone to sound when the CAUT button is pressed (message acknowledge) or when the failure condition no longer exists, but the caution CAS message on the EICAS stays as long as the failure condition exists.

master-warn-right.title: Master Warning (WARN) Button Right
master-warn-right.description: The Master Warning (WARN button) is installed on the glareshield panel and its red light blinks when a warning CAS message (red messages) comes on the EICAS. A specific aural tone is triggered together with the master warning red light. The red light stops to blink and the aural tone to sound when the WARN button is pressed (message acknowledge) or when the failure condition no longer exists, but the warning CAS message on the EICAS stays as long as the failure condition exists.

dcu1-baro-knob.title: BARO SET Knob
dcu1-baro-knob.description:
INNER:
  - Rotating the knob: sets the barometric altimeter correction.
  - Pushing the button: if there is a preselected barometric altitude value selected, activates the preselected value. Without having a preselected barometric altitude value displayed, push the button to set the barometric value to the standard values. Depending on the Baro Set Knob (IN/hPa), the standard value is 29.92 in or 1013 hPa.
OUTER:
  IN: Sets barometric correction format to inches of mercury.
  hPa: Sets barometric correction format to hecto Pascal.

dcu1-hsi-btn.title: Horizontal Situation indicator (HSI) Button
dcu1-hsi-btn.description: Selects between full compass, arc or map mode for the on side PFD.

dcu1-wx-btn.title: Weather Radar (WX) Button
dcu1-wx-btn.description: Displays Weather Radar information on PFD (HSI in arc or map mode only).

dcu1-fms-btn.title: FMS Button
dcu1-fms-btn.description: Selects the Flight Management System (FMS) as the primary navigation source displayed on PFD 1.

dcu1-brg1-btn.title: Bearing Source (BRG O) Button
dcu1-brg1-btn.description: Cycles the Circle (O) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 1, ADF 1, FMS 1, or OFF).

dcu1-prev-btn.title: Preview (PREV) Button
dcu1-prev-btn.description:
Selects the preview mode when the FMS is the primary navigation source. The course, and lateral and vertical deviation can be previewed.
- Pressing the first time: enables the on-side VOR/LOC preview.
- Pressing a second time: enables the opposite side VOR/LOC preview.
- Pressing a third time: disables the preview mode.
- The previewed navigation source automatically turns to the primary navigation source when captured by the light Director (FD) or by the Automatic Flight Control System (AFCS).

dcu1-nav-btn.title: Navigation Button (NAV)
dcu1-nav-btn.description: Selects VOR or LOC as the primary navigation source for the on-side PFD and toggles between VOR/LOC1 and VOR/LOC2.

dcu1-brg2-btn.title: Bearing Source (BRG ◇)
dcu1-brg2-btn.description: Cycles the Diamond (◇) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 2, ADF 2, FMS 2, or OFF).

dcu1-fpr-btn.title: Flight Path Reference Button (FPR)
dcu1-fpr-btn.description: Toggles the Flight Path Reference (FPR) line and Flight Path Vector (FPV) symbol on the Primary Flight Display (PFD 1).

dcu1-mins-knob.title: Left Minimums Controller
dcu1-mins-knob.description:
INNER:
  - Selects decision height (DH), decision altitude or minimum descent altitude based on OUTER position of MINIMUMS Knob.
OUTER:
  RA: Sets radio altimeter minimums.
  BARO: sets barometric minimums.

fgp-fd1-btn.title: Flight Director (FD) Button
fgp-fd1-btn.description:
Turns ON and OFF the Flight Director presentation on PFD.
If any of the following item is active, it is not possible to turn off the FD presentation on the PFD:
 -AP
 -TO
 -GA
 -WSHR
 -APPR2, or
 -RNP AR < 0.3.
NOTE: If AP is disengaged, to press FD button on any side,disengages the Flight Director modes.

fgp-crs1-knob.title: Course (CRS) Button
fgp-crs1-knob.description:
Manually sets the desired course on CDI as follows:
 - CDI displaying FMS: sets preview course.
 - CDI displaying VOR/LOC: sets CDI course
Pressing this knob indicates the course to the station.

fgp-spd-knob.title: SPEED Selector Knob
fgp-spd-knob.description:
FMS: The FMS logic controls the selected airspeed readout.
MAN:Selected airspeed readout is controlled manually.
  - Pressing this knob alternates the speed presentation on PFD selected airspeed readout window between IAS and MACH.

fgp-nav-btn.title: LNAV Button
fgp-nav-btn.description:
According to the presentation selected for the CDI the LNAV Button engages:
  - LOC: if the CDI is selected VOR/LOC (Green) and the source ILS frequency is tuned.
  - LNAV: if the CDI is selected FMS (Magenta).

fgp-hdg-knob.title: HDG SEL Controller
fgp-hdg-knob.description:
- Manually selects the desired heading.
 - Pressing this controller synchronizes the heading select to the current heading.

fgp-appr-btn.title: Approach (APPR) Mode Button
fgp-appr-btn.description: Arms lateral and vertical approach guidance (ILS LOC/GS or RNAV RNP/LPV approach).

fgp-bank-btn.title: BANK Button
fgp-bank-btn.description:
Enables and disables the low bank limit arc function during turns performed with HDG and NAV modes. The low bank limit arc is a visual reference on PFD to help pilots to avoid steep banks.
The low bank limit arc is manually commanded to on or off, or automatically commanded by the AFCS. The logic used by the AFCS for bank limit transition is:
  - Above 25000 ft the bank limit is 15°, and the white limit arc on the roll pointer of PFD is presented.
  - Below 25000 ft the bank limit is 30°, and there is no white limit arc presented.

fgp-ap-btn.title: AUTOPILOT Button
fgp-ap-btn.description: Engages or disengages the Automatic Flight Control System Autopilot.

fgp-src-btn.title: Navigation Source (SRC) Button
fgp-src-btn.description: Alternates between the left-hand or right-hand FMA modes as source for the autopilot. A green arrowhead on the FMA indicates the respective source selected.

fgp-appr2-btn.title: Approach (APPR) Button
fgp-appr2-btn.description:
Arms, activates, or deactivates approach modes based on the navigation source displayed on the respective PFD. For example, the following lateral and vertical mode annunciations are displayed on the FMA after the APPR button is pressed:
  - LOC and GS for the ILS approach mode.
  - LNAV and GP for the VGP approach mode.
The Autopilot Approach Status Annunciator displays the engaged approach mode.

fgp-alt-knob.title: ALT SEL Controller
fgp-alt-knob.description:
Selects desired altitude.
  - Clockwise rotation: increases the altitude target.
  - Counter clockwise rotation: decreases the altitude target.
  - Pressing this controller displays the selected altitude in meters above the selected altitude readout window on the PFD. Also displays the actual airplane altitude in meters above the altitude rolling digits readout window on the PFD.

fgp-alt-btn.title: Altitude Hold (ALT) Button
fgp-alt-btn.description: Engages Altitude Hold (ALT) mode, leveling the aircraft off and maintaining the current barometric altitude.

fgp-vs-wheel.title: Thumb Wheel Selector (DN / UP)
fgp-vs-wheel.description: Thumbwheel that adjusts the vertical speed (VS) target rate of climb/descent or the flight path angle (FPA) reference, whichever is selected.

fgp-vs-btn.title: Vertical Speed (VS) Button
fgp-vs-btn.description: Selects and deselects Vertical Speed (VS) mode.

fgp-fpa-btn.title: Flight Path Angle (FPA) Mode Button
fgp-fpa-btn.description: Selects and deselects Flight Path Angle (FPA) mode.

fgp-fd2-btn.title: Flight Director (FD) Button
fgp-fd2-btn.description:
Turns ON and OFF the Flight Director presentation on PFD.
If any of the following item is active, it is not possible to turn off the FD presentation on the PFD:
 -AP
 -TO
 -GA
 -WSHR
 -APPR2, or
 -RNP AR < 0.3.
NOTE: If AP is disengaged, to press FD button on any side,disengages the Flight Director modes.

fgp-crs2-knob.title: Course (CRS) Button
fgp-crs2-knob.description:
Manually sets the desired course on CDI as follows:
 - CDI displaying FMS: sets preview course.
 - CDI displaying VOR/LOC: sets CDI course
Pressing this knob indicates the course to the station.

dcu2-mins-knob.title: Left Minimums Controller
dcu2-mins-knob.description:
INNER:
  - Selects decision height (DH), decision altitude or minimum descent altitude based on OUTER position of MINIMUMS Knob.
OUTER:
  RA: Sets radio altimeter minimums.
  BARO: sets barometric minimums.

dcu2-hsi-btn.title: Horizontal Situation indicator (HSI) Button
dcu2-hsi-btn.description: Selects between full compass, arc or map mode for the on side PFD.

dcu2-wx-btn.title: Weather Radar (WX) Button
dcu2-wx-btn.description: Displays Weather Radar information on PFD (HSI in arc or map mode only).

dcu2-fms-btn.title: FMS Button
dcu2-fms-btn.description: Selects the Flight Management System (FMS) as the primary navigation source displayed on PFD 1.

dcu2-brg1-btn.title: Bearing Source (BRG O) Button
dcu2-brg1-btn.description: Cycles the Circle (O) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 1, ADF 1, FMS 1, or OFF).

dcu2-prev-btn.title: Preview (PREV) Button
dcu2-prev-btn.description:
Selects the preview mode when the FMS is the primary navigation source. The course, and lateral and vertical deviation can be previewed.
- Pressing the first time: enables the on-side VOR/LOC preview.
- Pressing a second time: enables the opposite side VOR/LOC preview.
- Pressing a third time: disables the preview mode.
- The previewed navigation source automatically turns to the primary navigation source when captured by the light Director (FD) or by the Automatic Flight Control System (AFCS).

dcu2-nav-btn.title: Navigation Button (NAV)
dcu2-nav-btn.description: Selects VOR or LOC as the primary navigation source for the on-side PFD and toggles between VOR/LOC1 and VOR/LOC2.

dcu2-brg2-btn.title: Bearing Source (BRG ◇)
dcu2-brg2-btn.description: Cycles the Diamond (◇) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 2, ADF 2, FMS 2, or OFF).

dcu2-fpr-btn.title: Flight Path Reference Button (FPR)
dcu2-fpr-btn.description: Toggles the Flight Path Reference (FPR) line and Flight Path Vector (FPV) symbol on the Primary Flight Display (PFD 1).

dcu2-baro-knob.title: BARO SET Knob
dcu2-baro-knob.description:
INNER:
  - Rotating the knob: sets the barometric altimeter correction.
  - Pushing the button: if there is a preselected barometric altitude value selected, activates the preselected value. Without having a preselected barometric altitude value displayed, push the button to set the barometric value to the standard values. Depending on the Baro Set Knob (IN/hPa), the standard value is 29.92 in or 1013 hPa.
OUTER:
  IN: Sets barometric correction format to inches of mercury.
  hPa: Sets barometric correction format to hecto Pascal.

css-btn.title: Cabin Surveillance System (CSS) Button
css-btn.description:
PUSH IN: Normal position.
PUSH OUT: Disables the CSS system by removing the power. A white striped bar illuminates on the button.

reversionary-left-knobs.title: Reversionary Panel
reversionary-left-knobs.description:
DISPLAYS Mode Knob
LEFT: DU 1 right half displays DU 2 information.
AUTO: automatic reversion between DU 1 and DU 2 in case of display failure.
RIGHT: DU 2 left half displays DU 1 information.

IRS BUTTON
PUSH: reverts the IRS source. When the reversion is selected, a white stripped bar illuminates the button.
NOTE: Associated IRS source indication is displayed on the PFD after a reversion takes place.

ADS BUTTON 
PUSH: reverts the ADS source. When the reversion is selected, a white stripped bar illuminates the button.
NOTE: Associated ADS source indication is displayed on the PFD after a reversion takes place.

autobrake-panel.title: AUTOBRAKE Selector Knob
autobrake-panel.description:
AUTOBRAKE SELECTOR KNOB (ROTARY ACTION)
- RTO: selects RTO deceleration mode.
- OFF: deactivates the autobrake.
- LO: selects the low deceleration rate.
- MED: selects the medium deceleration rate.
- HI: selects the high deceleration rate.

ldg-gear-lever.title: Landing Gear Control Lever (UP / OFF / DN)
ldg-gear-lever.description:
UP: Commands landing gear retraction and door closure.
OFF: Depressurizes the landing gear hydraulic lines.
DN: Commands landing gear extension and down-locking.

emer-parking-brake-light.title: EMER/PARKING BRAKE Light
emer-parking-brake-light.description:
ON: the indicator illuminates when the a minimum pressure is identified.
The indicator does not provide advice to prevent locked wheel and skid conditions.

gear-ovrd-btn.title: DN LCK REL (Downlock Release) Button & NOSEWHEEL STEERING Switch
gear-ovrd-btn.description:
DN LOCK REL: Downlock Release Button (Momentary Action). Mechanically overrides the landing gear lever lock to allow gear retraction in emergency conditions.

STEERING: Disengages nosewheel steering system.

ads-heater-btn.title: ADS HEATER BUTTON
ads-heater-btn.description:
PUSH IN: Activates the ADS probes heater. A striped bar illuminates in the button.
PUSH OUT: The ADS probes heater operates in AUTO mode.

reversionary-right-knobs.title: Reversionary Panel
reversionary-right-knobs.description:
DISPLAYS Mode Knob
LEFT: DU 3 right half displays DU 4 information. 
AUTO: automatic reversion between DU 3 and DU 4 in case of display failure. 
RIGHT: DU 4 left half displays DU 3 information.

IRS BUTTON
PUSH: reverts the IRS source. When the reversion is selected, a white stripped bar illuminates the button.
NOTE: Associated IRS source indication is displayed on the PFD after a reversion takes place.

ADS BUTTON 
PUSH: reverts the ADS source. When the reversion is selected, a white stripped bar illuminates the button.
NOTE: Associated ADS source indication is displayed on the PFD after a reversion takes place.

flight-control-mode.title: FLIGHT CONTROL MODE / STALL WARNIG Panel
flight-control-mode.description:
FLIGHT CONTROL MODE BUTTON (GUARDED)
  In air, whenever the system conditions permit, reverts the flight control system either from Normal Mode to Direct Mode, orfrom Direct Mode to Normal Mode. The system supports up tofive transitions. After the fifth transition, only Direct Mode isavailable.
NOTE: The Flight Control System can automatically revert to the direct mode due to system failure. In this case, the request to recover the normal mode is performed by pressing the Flight Control Mode Button.

mcdu-left-keys.title: Left MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons (MCDU 1)
mcdu-left-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 1.

mcdu-right-keys.title: Right MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons (MCDU 2)
mcdu-right-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 2.

eng1-ign-knob.title: Engine 1 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)
eng1-ign-knob.description: Controls Engine 1 igniters. AUTO: FADEC automatically controls ignition. OVRD: Continuous ignition on both igniters. OFF: Inhibits ignition for dry motoring.

eng2-ign-knob.title: Engine 2 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)

eng1-start-knob.title: Engine 1 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng1-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector. RUN: Normal operating position. START: Momentary position initiating FADEC automatic start sequence. STOP: Shuts down Engine 1.

eng2-start-knob.title: Engine 2 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng2-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector for Engine 2 automatic starting (START), normal operation (RUN), and shutdown (STOP).

to-config-btn.title: T/O CONFIG Check Button
to-config-btn.description:
Test button is provided to allow checking the takeoff configuration by simulating power levers in the advanced position. If the airplane is in takeoff configuration, the voice message 'TAKEOFF OK' is generated. If the airplane is not set to takeoff configuration, the aural warning referred to the associated takeoff configuration deviation is generated.

 The aural warning is activated whenever the airplane is on the ground, thrust is applied, and at least one of the following conditions is met:
- Flaps are not in takeoff position ('NO TAKEOFF FLAPS').
- Flaps position is not in agreement with the Flaps position selected in the FMS Takeoff page 2/2. ('NO TAKEOFF FLAPS').
- The Emergency/Parking Brake is applied ('NO TAKEOFF BRAKES').
- Pitch trim is out of green range ('NO TAKEOFF TRIM').
- Any spoiler panel is deployed ('NO TAKEOFF SPOILER').

ccd-pedestal-left.title: Left Cursor Control Device (CCD 1 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-left.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the Captain to move the cursor across PFD 1, MFD 1, and MCDU 1.

ccd-pedestal-right.title: Right Cursor Control Device (CCD 2 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-right.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the First Officer to move the cursor across MFD 2, PFD 2, and MCDU 2.

speedbrake-lever.title: SPEED BRAKE Lever (CLOSE / OPEN)
speedbrake-lever.description: Controls deployment of the wing multifunction spoilers as speedbrakes in flight.

thrust-levers.title: Engine 1 & 2 Thrust Levers (MAX / TOGA / MCT / IDLE / REV)
thrust-levers.description: Forward thrust and thrust-reverser levers with TO/GA (Takeoff/Go-Around) buttons and A/T quick-disconnect switches.

eicas-full-btn.title: EICAS FULL Pushbutton
eicas-full-btn.description: Toggles full-screen EICAS engine and system indications on the Multi-Function Display when pressed.

rat-manual-deploy-lever.title: RAT MANUAL DEPLOY (Ram Air Turbine) Lever
rat-manual-deploy-lever.description: Pulling the RAT MANUAL DEPLOY lever manually deploys the Ram Air Turbine (RAT) to provide emergency electrical power.

parking-brake.title: PARKING / EMERGENCY BRAKE Handle
parking-brake.description: Pulling and rotating applies hydraulic parking brake pressure; also provides proportional mechanical/hydraulic emergency brake application.

acp-left-panel.title: Left Audio Control Panel (ACP 1)
acp-left-panel.description: Captain Audio Control Panel: selects transmission buttons (VHF 1/2/3, HF, SAT, PA, INT) and reception volume knobs, oxygen mask/boom mic switch, and emergency audio backup.

acp-right-panel.title: Right Audio Control Panel (ACP 2)
acp-right-panel.description: First Officer Audio Control Panel: selects transmission buttons (VHF 1/2/3, HF, SAT, PA, INT), reception volume knobs, mask/boom switch, and emergency audio backup.

trim-panel.title: TRIM Panel (ROLL, YAW & PITCH Backup Trim & SYS 1/2 Cutout)
trim-panel.description: Contains ROLL trim switch (LWD/RWD), YAW trim switch, PITCH BACKUP switch (UP/DN), and guarded PITCH TRIM SYS 1 / SYS 2 cutout pushbuttons.

cockpit-door-panel.title: COCKPIT DOOR Control Panel (OPEN / INHIB / TEST)
cockpit-door-panel.description: Controls electronic locking/unlocking and access inhibition of the reinforced cockpit door. Includes OPEN, INHIB, and TEST pushbuttons/indicators.

cockpit-printer.title: Cockpit Thermal Printer
cockpit-printer.description: Prints ACARS datalink messages, weather reports (METAR/TAF), ATIS, clearances, flight plans, and maintenance reports. Includes PAPER, SLEW, and TEST/ERROR controls.

flap-lever.title: Flap Selector Lever (0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / FULL)
flap-lever.description: Selects wing trailing-edge flap and leading-edge slat positions for takeoff, approach, and landing.

pa-btn-left.title: Captain PA (Passenger Address) Handset / Button
pa-btn-left.description: Captain Passenger Address handset socket and push-to-talk button located below the Parking / Emergency Brake handle for making cabin announcements.

pa-btn-right.title: First Officer PA (Passenger Address) Handset / Button
pa-btn-right.description: First Officer Passenger Address handset socket and push-to-talk button located below the Flap Selector Lever.

elevator-disc-handle.title: ELEVATOR DISC (Elevator Disconnect) Handle
elevator-disc-handle.description: Pulling the T-handle mechanically disconnects the left and right elevator control systems in the event of a jammed elevator.

aileron-disc-handle.title: AILERON DISC (Aileron Disconnect) Handle
aileron-disc-handle.description: Pulling the T-handle mechanically disconnects the left and right aileron control systems in the event of a jammed aileron.

lgwrn-gnd-prox-inhibits.title: LG WRN / GROUND PROX INHIBITS Panel (LG WRN / TERR / FLAP OVRD)
lgwrn-gnd-prox-inhibits.description: Contains guarded pushbuttons for Landing Gear Warning Inhibit (LG WRN INHB), Terrain Inhibit (TERR INHB), and Flap Override (FLAP OVRD).

cabin-non-essential.title: CABIN NON ESSENTIAL Power Switch
cabin-non-essential.description: Guarded pushbutton that sheds non-essential cabin electrical power (galley, in-flight entertainment, cabin outlets) in case of cabin smoke or electrical overload.

lower-pedestal-panel.title: Cockpit Voice Recorder / Maintenance Test Panel
lower-pedestal-panel.description: Lower pedestal panel located directly below the CABIN NON ESSENTIAL switch.

fgp-vnav-btn.title: Vertical Navigation (VNAV) Button
fgp-vnav-btn.description: Engages or arms FMS Vertical Navigation (VNAV) profile guidance, following pre-programmed vertical waypoints, altitude constraints, and speeds.

fgp-flch-btn.title: Flight Level Change (FLCH) Button
fgp-flch-btn.description: Engages Flight Level Change (FLCH) mode. The AFCS commands pitch to maintain the selected airspeed while throttles deliver climb or idle descent thrust.

ptt-capt-btn.title: Captain PTT / Boom Mic Jack
ptt-capt-btn.description: Auxiliary jack and push-to-talk (PTT) interface on the captain's glareshield panel for connecting the boom microphone or headset.

chart-light-capt-knob.title: Captain CHART Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
chart-light-capt-knob.description: Controls illumination of the captain's chart holder / clip light. Rotating clockwise from OFF smoothly increases brightness to maximum (BRT).

flood-storm-capt-knob.title: Captain FLOOD / STORM Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
flood-storm-capt-knob.description: Controls the captain's side glareshield floodlight and storm lighting. Rotating clockwise from OFF increases illumination to maximum brightness (BRT).

pfd-light-capt-knob.title: Captain PFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
pfd-light-capt-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the Captain's Primary Flight Display (PFD 1) from DIM to BRT.

mfd-light-capt-knob.title: Captain MFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
mfd-light-capt-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the Captain's Multi-Function Display (MFD 1) from DIM to BRT.

compass-light-fo-knob.title: COMPASS / Glareshield Light Knob (DIM / BRT)
compass-light-fo-knob.description: Controls the magnetic compass light and supplemental glareshield integral illumination from DIM to maximum brightness (BRT).

mfd-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer MFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
mfd-light-fo-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the First Officer's Multi-Function Display (MFD 2 / EICAS) from DIM to BRT.

pfd-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer PFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
pfd-light-fo-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the First Officer's Primary Flight Display (PFD 2) from DIM to BRT.

flood-storm-fo-knob.title: First Officer FLOOD / STORM Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
flood-storm-fo-knob.description: Controls the First Officer's side glareshield floodlight and storm lighting. Rotating clockwise from OFF increases illumination to maximum brightness (BRT).

chart-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer CHART Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
chart-light-fo-knob.description: Controls illumination of the First Officer's chart holder / clip light. Rotating clockwise from OFF smoothly increases brightness to maximum (BRT).

ptt-fo-btn.title: First Officer PTT / Boom Mic Jack
ptt-fo-btn.description: Auxiliary jack and push-to-talk (PTT) interface on the First Officer's glareshield panel for connecting the boom microphone or headset.
